# Integrate the maximal harness and CI/CD

**Parent:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/1  
**GitHub issue:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/5  
**Conductor phase:** Phase 4  
**Requirements:** M-040–M-046, M-060–M-063

## Acceptance criteria

- Unit, integration, end-to-end, smoke, property, mutation, and parity lanes.
- Coverage strictly above 90% with Codecov.
- `ty` routine and BasedPyright formal typing.
- Scalene profiling and benchmark evidence.
- Renovate, CodeQL, actionlint, zizmor, SBOM, attestations, and SHA-pinned Actions.
- Dry-run Conductor/GitHub synchronization.
